title: The Last Lighthouse
description: A retired ferry captain returns to a fog-bound island off Newfoundland to run its failing lighthouse, and slowly reconnects with the daughter she left behind.

title: Orbit of Ash
description: Stranded on a dying research station orbiting Jupiter, an engineer has nine days to build a lifeboat from scrap before her oxygen runs out.

title: Crumb & Clue
description: A village baker solves murders between morning batches, using gossip from the queue at her counter and a sharp eye for lies.

title: Prairie Static
description: A tiny Saskatchewan radio station with three listeners and a broken transmitter tries to win a national broadcasting award.

title: Under the Canopy
description: A wildlife crew spends a year high in the rainforest canopy of Borneo, filming orangutans, hornbills and the insects that hold the forest together.

title: Midnight Ledger
description: A junior accountant discovers her firm is laundering money for a cartel and must decide whether to run or gather enough evidence to bring them down.

title: Ten Burners
description: Twelve home cooks compete in a converted warehouse kitchen. Each week brings a new cuisine, a mystery basket and one cook sent home.

title: The Glass Orchard
description: Two rival glassblowers forced to share a studio for a summer festival fall for each other while racing to finish a commission.

title: Hollow Pines
description: Campers at a remote lake in northern Ontario begin disappearing one by one after a counsellor plays an old cassette found under the boathouse.

title: Starward Academy
description: A clumsy young pilot and her robot best friend join a flight school for kids on a floating city, learning teamwork one crash landing at a time.

title: Fourth Quarter
description: An injured basketball star coaches a struggling high school team in his hometown and rediscovers why he loved the game.

title: Iron Meridian
description: In 1880s Alberta, a railway surveyor and a disgraced lawman pursue a gang of train robbers across the foothills.

title: Deep Current
description: Marine biologists follow humpback whales on their migration from Hawaii to Alaska, using drones and underwater microphones to listen in.

title: Thin Blue Lies
description: A homicide detective in Vancouver investigates a string of killings linked to a corrupt police union, and starts to suspect her own partner.

title: The Sourdough Years
description: Stuck in a tiny apartment, two mismatched roommates turn a failed sourdough starter into an accidental online bakery empire.

title: Kingdom of Thorns
description: An exiled princess teams up with a band of outlaws and a reluctant dragon to win back a throne stolen by her uncle's sorcery.

title: Signal Lost
description: A night-shift 911 dispatcher takes a call from a kidnapped girl whose phone battery is dying, and has one hour to find her.

title: Paper Hearts
description: At a performing arts high school, a shy songwriter and the school's star dancer team up for the senior showcase and start writing more than songs.

title: Mapping the Dark
description: Cave divers attempt to map a vast flooded cave system in Mexico, where one wrong turn in the darkness means no way back.

title: Office of Lost Things
description: Staff at a city transit lost-and-found office reunite strangers with forgotten umbrellas, urns and one very confused parrot.

title: Red Planet Harvest
description: The first farming colony on Mars struggles through dust storms, failed crops and a growing rebellion against the company that owns the air.

title: Blood Moon Motel
description: A couple on a road trip check into a desert motel where every other guest seems to have arrived on the same night forty years ago.

title: The Long Pass
description: A season inside a women's professional hockey team as players balance training, day jobs and a fight for league recognition.

title: Spice Route
description: A chef travels from Kerala to Zanzibar to Grenada, tracing the history of pepper, cloves and nutmeg through the dishes they shaped.

title: Little Fox Detectives
description: Two fox cubs solve gentle mysteries in their woodland town, like who took the moon from the pond and why the river stopped singing.

title: Rust and Rain
description: After the steel mill closes, a father and his teenage son rebuild a vintage motorcycle and ride across the country to his estranged brother.

title: The Quiet Partner
description: A brilliant defence lawyer with a hidden gambling debt takes on a case that could free her client and end her own career.

title: Glacier Station
description: When a scientist vanishes from an Antarctic research base during the polar night, the eleven people left behind begin to suspect each other.

title: Laugh Track
description: Behind the scenes of a failing nineties sitcom, the cast and crew bicker, flirt and improvise their way through one last season.

title: Neon Drift
description: A getaway driver in a rain-soaked future Tokyo takes one final job and finds a stolen android hiding in her trunk.

title: Wild Kitchen
description: A forager and a chef cook over open fires in the Canadian Rockies using only what they can find, catch or trade for that day.

title: Seven Summers
description: Two friends meet at the same lakeside cottage every summer for seven years, always missing the right moment to say how they feel.

title: Spirit Lodge
description: A struggling wedding planner inherits a haunted ski lodge and must stop its grumpy resident ghost from scaring off her first clients.

title: Zero Day Morning
description: A security analyst has one morning to stop a ransomware attack that has locked the computers of every hospital in the city.

title: The Clockmaker's Apprentice
description: A Victorian orphan apprenticed to a clockmaker finds a pocket watch that rewinds time by ten minutes, and the men who want it back.

title: Atlas of Ice
description: Scientists and northern communities track how Arctic sea ice is changing, and what it means for polar bears, seals and the people who live there.

title: Gilded Halls
description: A new student at an elite boarding school uncovers the secret society that really runs the place, and is invited to join it.

title: Kiln Fire
description: Potters compete to throw, glaze and fire a new piece each week, from teapots to giant garden urns, judged by master ceramicists.

title: Northern Lights Diner
description: Regulars at a 24-hour truck stop on the Alaska Highway share their stories with the night waitress who never seems to sleep.

title: The Rabbit Job
description: A crew of out-of-work stage magicians plans to rob a casino using illusions, misdirection and one very nervous rabbit.

title: Night Rounds
description: First-year residents survive brutal overnight shifts in a downtown Toronto emergency room while the hospital fights budget cuts.

title: Beneath the Dunes
description: An archaeologist and a smuggler race across the Sahara to find a buried city before a mining company blasts it apart.

title: Small Town Spells
description: A witch who runs a tea shop in a sleepy mountain town keeps her magic secret, until her potions start curing the wrong problems.

title: Charging Ahead
description: How cities from Oslo to Shenzhen are racing to replace gas cars with electric buses, e-bikes and charging networks.

title: Last Song at the Paramount
description: A fading jazz singer gets one last shot at a comeback when a young pianist talks her into headlining the reopening of an old theatre.

title: Tornado Alley Diaries
description: Meteorologists and storm chasers drive into the heart of supercell thunderstorms on the American plains to collect data that saves lives.

title: Byte Club
description: Four burned-out software developers quit their jobs to build a startup in a garage, with no money, no plan and one overconfident app idea.

title: The Cartographer's Daughter
description: In 1600s Amsterdam, a mapmaker's daughter secretly finishes her late father's atlas while merchants and spies fight over its secrets.

title: Hull Breach
description: When a submarine loses power under the Arctic ice, its youngest officer must lead a repair dive in freezing, pitch-black water.

title: Weekend Plot
description: A landscape designer and a carpenter turn neglected backyards into gardens in just two days, and the neighbours vote on the result.

title: The Missing Hour
description: Five friends wake up in a cabin with no memory of the past hour and a stranger's car in the driveway, and each of them is hiding something.

title: Captain Paws
description: A rescue dog who believes she is a superhero patrols her neighbourhood, helping lost kittens, scared toddlers and one very stuck squirrel.

title: Two Rivers
description: Two brothers on opposite sides of a land dispute in rural Manitoba must work together when a spring flood threatens the family farm.

title: Empires of Salt
description: How salt built and broke empires, from Roman roads and imperial Chinese monopolies to India's Salt March.

title: Second Draft
description: A romance novelist with writer's block agrees to fake-date her harshest critic to promote her book, and the reviews get complicated.

title: The Woods Remember
description: A family moves into a farmhouse beside an old forest where the trees seem to whisper the names of the people who will disappear next.

title: Copy of Me
description: A widow discovers her late husband uploaded a digital copy of himself before he died, and now it wants to come home.

title: Sweep the Nation
description: A rag-tag curling team from a small Alberta town makes an unlikely run at the national championship, armed with brooms and bad jokes.

title: After Dark
description: Thermal cameras reveal what owls, bats, raccoons and coyotes get up to in our cities while people sleep.

title: The Vanishing on Route 9
description: Journalists reopen the decades-old disappearance of a teenage hitchhiker, interviewing witnesses who have stayed silent for thirty years.
